name: Post Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students
description: The Post Matric Scholarship Scheme for Scheduled Castes is a centrally sponsored scheme to provide financial assistance to SC students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stages to enable them to complete their education. The scholarship includes tuition fee reimbursement, maintenance allowance, and academic allowances.
eligibility: 1. Student must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 2. Must be studying in an approved Post-Matriculation course in a recognized institution. 3. Annual family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 2.5 Lakh per annum. 4. Should not be receiving any other government-sponsored scholarship.
documents: 1. Passport size Photograph 2. Caste Certificate issued by competent authority 3. Income Certificate of parents 4. Marksheet of the last qualifying examination 5. Fee receipt of the current academic year 6. Bank Passbook copy (Aadhaar-linked account) 7. Aadhaar Card
steps: 1. Go to the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) website at https://scholarships.gov.in/ or your State's Scholarship Portal. 2. Click on 'New Registration' and read the guidelines. Enter your State of Domicile, scholarship category, name, mobile, and bank account details. 3. Log in using the generated Application ID and OTP received on your mobile. 4. Fill in the application form with your academic details, fees paid, and personal details. 5. Upload scans of your Caste Certificate (SC), Income Certificate, and Marks/Academic transcripts. 6. Submit the form online and print a copy. Hand the printout and physical documents to your College/Institution for verification.
